# Newline-delimited regexes. Lines starting with # are comments.
# These patterns are matched against a composed check string:
# detector=... | verified=... | repo=... | file=... | redacted=...
# Keep them specific to avoid missing true positives.

# Example Postgres DSN from docs and READMEs (wildcard DB name)
postgres:\/\/username:password@hostname:\d+\/[^\/\s]+

# Common placeholder tokens that are not real secrets
\bexample(_|-)?(user|username|token|password|pass|key)\b
\busername:password@hostname\b
\bchangeme\b
\bplaceholder\b

# Docs-only areas (avoid if you actually want to scan docs):
# Note: these match the composed "file=" field, not the raw path.
# file=.*\/docs\/
# file=.*\/doc\/
# file=.*\/examples?\/
# file=.*README(\.md|\.rst)?$
